purpose: Deterministic follow-up and meeting-booking sub-state machine that refines PERSUASION -> EXECUTION -> MEASUREMENT for one outreach thread (account x product x person). 跟进与约会议是可中断、可测量的状态机，不是自由发挥的节奏。

binding.execution_rule: Every touch that leaves DRAFT_READY passes the EXECUTION policy gate (jurisdiction/suppression/approval/idempotency) individually; the sub-machine never bypasses it.
binding.reply_rule: Substantive replies pause the whole ACCOUNT x PRODUCT motion per reply-routing-policy-v1.0, across all parallel person threads.

DRAFT_READY.description: channel draft passed OUTREACH_CHANNEL_POLICY gate; awaiting governed send

SENT.description: touch 1 dispatched through EXECUTION gate; awaiting signal

OPENED.description: open/read signal observed; still no reply

NO_REPLY.description: no-reply window elapsed; follow-up scheduling allowed

FOLLOWUP_1.description: touch 2 sent: same thread, NEW information angle, shorter

FOLLOWUP_2.description: touch 3 sent: channel or role-framing pivot, opt-down question

FOLLOWUP_3.description: touch 4 sent: professional breakup + standing value artifact

HUMAN_TAKEOVER.description: substantive reply received; automation paused for the account x product; human classifies and drives

MEETING_PROPOSED.description: meeting ask sent: 2 concrete slots in recipient timezone, duration, one-line agenda

MEETING_BOOKED.description: slot accepted; confirmation pack must be completed before confirmed

MEETING_CONFIRMED.description: confirmation pack complete incl. T-24h reconfirm

QUALIFIED_OPPORTUNITY.description: pain/fit/next-step confirmed by the buyer; hand off to opportunity motion

NURTURE.description: fit without timing; re-enters via a NEW timing trigger through QUALIFICATION, never by blind re-send

CLOSED_LOST.description: explicit no-fit or hard rejection; reason taxonomy recorded

HOLD.description: policy/approval/jurisdiction/data block; returns to the responsible upstream stage

UNSUBSCRIBED.description: opt-out; suppression list write; no re-entry without new lawful basis

global_interrupts.effect: automation_paused=true for ACCOUNT x PRODUCT before classification
suppression write; all threads for the person stop
contact data repair before any further touch
responsible upstream stage owns the repair

transitions.note: route back to BUYING_COMMITTEE with referral evidence
only for non-substantive resolutions (OOO/auto-reply) per reply-routing-policy

channel_switch_rules.WHATSAPP: requires consent_or_existing_business_relationship evidence on the sequence

hard_rules: A terminal state accepts no further events.
HUMAN_TAKEOVER can only be exited by an explicit human classification event.
followup_due earlier than min_interval_days since the last touch is a violation, not a warning.
Touch count above max_touches_per_sequence is impossible by construction.
NURTURE re-entry requires a NEW timing trigger and passes QUALIFICATION again; it never restarts the sequence in place.
MEETING_BOOKED cannot become MEETING_CONFIRMED without the full confirmation pack.
MEETING_HELD cannot exit without the debrief written back to the evidence ledger.
